Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 24h concurrency sweep for checkout POC – trial/top-up ask

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the Redwood response times looked promising. We want to run a 24-hour concurrency sweep across our checkout traffic profile to validate tail latency and throughput under sustained load before the end of quarter demo.

High level ask: can Redwood temporarily extend our trial window and add an extra 120k token-equivalent credits (or an equivalent sandbox budget) for the sweep? We expect peaks of ~250 concurrent streams and an average session length of 180 tokens.

Attached is a short load plan and the list of endpoints we'll exercise. If you need a PO or an MSA addendum to approve this, let me know; we can fast-track with procurement.

Thanks —
Olivia Tan
Head of Platform Engineering
SmartRetail AI
[Attachment: load-plan.csv (text/csv)]

Hi Olivia —

Appreciate the details and the load plan. Looping in Lauren from Sales Ops to confirm sandbox budget and any compliance notes for a longer run.

Quick clarifying Qs from our side:
- Can you confirm the time window (UTC) you'd like the sweep to run?
- Are there any sensitive customer payloads in the test data (we need to ensure no PII touches host logs for the Private trial)?

We typically handle requests like this by: 1) issuing a time-bound credit top-up to the account, and 2) provisioning a burst-capacity window on Dedicated if needed. I’ll coordinate the exact amount once Lauren confirms.

Best,

Folks — forwarding SmartRetail's ask. Summary: they want a 24h sustained concurrency sweep (~250 concurrents, avg 180 tokens/session). Marissa estimates ~120k token-equivalent credits required to run the full sweep plus buffer.

Attachments: load-plan.csv, SLA-expectations.pdf

Can we approve a temporary grant as follows?
- 120,000 token credits, valid for 7 days starting when the run begins
- Sandbox burst window: enable 2x concurrency for up to 6 hours if they hit a spike

If finance needs a supporting PO, they can accept a short-term PO or a billing hold. Rishi — can you confirm whether this fits within our promotional allowance for proof-of-scale tests? Ben — any finance constraints?

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Sales Operations Manager
